title: 3598. Longest Common Prefix Between Adjacent Strings After Removals

examples.explanation: Removing index 0: words becomes ["run", "run", "jump", "run"] Longest adjacent pair is ["run", "run"] having a common prefix "run" (length 3) Removing index 1: words becomes ["jump", "run", "jump", "run"] No adjacent pairs share a common prefix (length 0) Removing index 2: words becomes ["jump", "run", "jump", "run"] No adjacent pairs share a common prefix (length 0) Removing index 3: words becomes ["jump", "run", "run", "run"] Longest adjacent pair is ["run", "run"] having a common prefix "run" (length 3) Removing index 4: words becomes ["jump", "run", "run", "jump"] Longest adjacent pair is ["run", "run"] having a common prefix "run" (length 3)
Removing any index results in an answer of 0.
